title: What makes a fight feel powerful?
access_note: Small attributed excerpts from official public readers and a publisher Look inside preview. Public viewing is not a reuse license. Full episodes remain on the linked services. These references are separate from original production art and are never image-generation inputs.

entries.title: The face takes the punch
entries.locator: Official reader image segment 52 (one-based; not a printed page number)
entries.excerpt_transform: Limited crop and downscale only; no retouch or AI processing
entries.observation: One blue glove, a compressed face and a black field. The target carries the impact; the setting contributes almost nothing.
entries.experiment: Try a close peak-impact cut with deformed cheeks, rotated head and compressed shoulder. Keep only contact-bearing spray.
entries.limitation: The contact crop does not explain the whole exchange; inspect the official episode for setup.

entries.limitation: The streaks do not alone prove a successful hit; this is an evasion-and-speed reference.

entries.title: The body folds around the wound

entries.excerpt_transform: Limited crop and downscale only; no retouch or AI processing
entries.observation: Bent legs, an arched torso and trailing blood make the strike a bodily event, even with much of the attacker outside frame.

entries.limitation: Injury and high effect density may be undesirable. This is a force/cost reference, not an endorsement of its detail load.
